recommendation: Keep the source fix. It completes the documented FHIR-31818 clarification in the active Ingredient resource without changing cardinality, datatypes, bindings, or conformance semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-31818 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core BRR change request against MedicinalProductIngredient asking what measurementPoint means and requesting examples; the accepted resolution was to improve documentation for R5.
initial_application: The issue was applied in Ingredient after MedicinalProductIngredient was replaced by Ingredient. Commits 72c7bcfe and 464b98e6 explicitly mentioned FHIR#31818 and added the inhaler/point-of-aerosolization explanation to Ingredient.substance.strength.measurementPoint, but left Ingredient.substance.strength.referenceStrength.measurementPoint with the original terse definition.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Ingredient as an active resource and maps the historical MedicinalProductIngredient artifact to Ingredient. The old MedicinalProductIngredient source contained both strength.measurementPoint and referenceStrength.measurementPoint rows, so the reference-strength row is a current build-scope parallel source location. FHIR-31819 improved the neighboring referenceStrength parent definition, and FHIR-31821 later changed strength datatype choices without addressing measurementPoint wording. Zulip and Confluence searches found no evidence narrowing FHIR-31818 to only the non-reference-strength row.
reconciliation: Updated source/ingredient/structuredefinition-Ingredient.xml so Ingredient.substance.strength.referenceStrength.measurementPoint now carries the same explanatory definition and inhaler example as Ingredient.substance.strength.measurementPoint.
source_changes: source/ingredient/structuredefinition-Ingredient.xml: clarified Ingredient.substance.strength.referenceStrength.measurementPoint with the same inhaler/point-of-aerosolization example already applied to Ingredient.substance.strength.measurementPoint.

related_jiras.note: Improved the neighboring referenceStrength definition; it explains why the parent row did not need further reconciliation for FHIR-31818.
